caseNameFull: Campbell, Federal Prohibition Administrator v. Galeno Chemical Co., Inc. Same v. D. P. Paul & Co., Inc. and Same v. W. H. Long & Co.
attorneys: Solicitor General Hughes, and Messrs. John Henry McEvers and Mahlon D. Kiefer, for petitioners., Mr. Charles Dicker-man Williams for Galeno Chemical Company et al. and D. P. Paul & Company; and Mr. Lewis Landes for W. H. Long & Co.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit granted.

Mr. Charles Dicker-man Williams for Galeno Chemical Company et al. and D. P. Paul & Company; and Mr. Lewis Landes for W. H. Long & Co.
